cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de facturas de compra activas en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM purchase_invoice pi WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_facturas FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se compró a cada proveedor en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, SUM(pi.total_amount) AS total FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) AS total_comprado FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi JOIN public.supplier AS s ON pi.supplier_id = s.id WHERE pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND pi.active = TRUE GROUP BY s.business_name ORDER BY total_comprado DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se pagó por cada medio de pago a proveedores en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(pp.amount) AS total FROM purchase_payment pp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = pp.payment_type_id WHERE pp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND pp.paid_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio_pago, COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS total_pagado FROM public.purchase_payment AS pp JOIN public.purchase_invoice AS pi ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON pp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY pt.name ORDER BY total_pagado DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántas unidades recibidas hubo por producto en órdenes de compra de octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(poi.quantity_received) AS unidades FROM purchase_order po JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN product p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND po.issued_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity_received), 0) AS unidades_recibidas FROM public.purchase_order AS po JOIN public.purchase_order_item AS poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN public.product AS p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND po.issued_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY unidades_recibidas DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en octubre de 2026? Indica el proveedor, la serie, el número y el saldo pendiente de cada factura.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
